features.outcome: Retain an owner-entered current bill without impersonating a provider sync
features.happy_path: Sign in, open Bills, enter creditor/type/current USD due amount and real due date, select autopay knowledge, explicitly confirm own currently unpaid bill; retain exact owner-bound user assertion and show saved record proof. Refresh does not imply payment.

input_schema.obligation: validated amount_due_cents, creditor, due_on, currency, autopay

features.source_of_truth: User assertion, visibly distinct from provider evidence.
features.owner_scope: Verified Auth user plus owned obligation/account; never request body user_id.
features.auth_and_consent: Reading and preparation require owner session. Payment requires distinct current exact approval; data linking grants no payment authority.
features.eligibility: Current domain supports USD obligations; live provider/institution/payee eligibility unverified.
features.fees_and_limits: No implied zero fee. Unknown fee/timing/rail prevents live payment; limits must be bound to current provider quote.
features.upstream_partner: No production biller or payment adapter registered.
dependencies: provider capability and launch approval for writes
features.data_freshness: As-of time retained. Planner requires bill evidence within 48h and funding within 15m; stale evidence blocks payment.
features.failure_and_recovery: Malformed, foreign or materially mismatched receipt cannot clear the form or announce success. Lost response reuses the same entry UUID for unchanged details; changed details use a new UUID. Server rejects reused UUID with changed terms. Confirmed save followed by failed list refresh retains the masked saved ID and asks to reload.
features.telemetry: Audit IDs, state transitions and reason codes only; omit raw bill data, tokens, account identifiers and model context.
features.user_copy: Bill saved from the current details you confirmed. No payment was made.
launch_gates: No production provider access or release approval established.
features.next_step: Inspect the built mobile/desktop journey in an enabled browser, complete exact provider/delivery contracts and retain disabled financial writes until launch gates pass.
known_gaps: Actual browser/accessibility and screenshots absent; Node DOM is synthetic.
All supported user-entry UI amounts are USD; full multicurrency unresolved.
No verified biller/payment provider or deployed workflow endpoint established.
features.design_provenance: Upmore workflow requirement decomposed from bill-payment seed; detailed competitor equivalence is not established by broad product-page claims.

features.outcome: Confirm or dismiss a recurring-payment candidate without treating a past charge as current debt
features.happy_path: Explicitly select a retained bank candidate, compare its inferred amount/date with the current statement, enter corrected current facts and confirm unpaid ownership. Keep original bank provenance; dismiss only that candidate with a separate explicit local action.

output_schema.obligation: current user-confirmed bill or dismissed candidate

output_schema.report: owner-bound paginated candidates, exclusions, retained source references and incomplete coverage

features.source_of_truth: Retained owner-scoped bank facts, not proof of duplicate purchase or charge-specific refund allocation.
features.owner_scope: Auth UID and exact scoped accounts; no body identity or admin fallback.
features.auth_and_consent: Read and preparation only. There is no send, approve, payment or claim submission operation.
features.eligibility: USD observed retained facts; unknown pending dates excluded. No universal provider/institution coverage.
features.fees_and_limits: No external fee or action. Atomic read limited to 10,000 transactions and 1,000 accounts; overflow fails explicitly.
features.upstream_partner: Existing retained SimpleFIN data; no newly verified bank connection or refund-allocation provider.
dependencies: trusted allocation evidence before verified recovery
features.data_freshness: Bank fetch/observation times retained separately from scan preparation time. Stale/disconnected history is labeled; source hash binds pagination.
features.failure_and_recovery: Reject foreign/missing accounts, invalid facts and oversized snapshot. Reload after source changes. Unknown holds are excluded, never dated from ingestion time. No financial retry/effect exists.
features.telemetry: No new telemetry; never log raw bank snapshot or drafts.
features.user_copy: Candidates only. No request was sent and no recovered amount was verified.
launch_gates: No production provider access or release approval established.
features.next_step: Add durable recovery cases and protected verified allocation, then browser and supported provider proof. Native alert parity remains incomplete.
known_gaps: No automatic alert delivery, provider refund allocation, durable recovery case, cross-case deduplication or external request.
Actual browser/accessibility and screenshots absent; DOM and app VM are synthetic.
Migration18 local only; no production release.
features.design_provenance: Upmore decomposition from duplicate-charge seed plus original S48 preparation contract; equivalent authenticated Capital One behavior is not established.
